en: (I should be safe here...)
Oh? Hey, you! Mister\nspaced-out space\ncaptain!!!
I have an important job\nfor you!

Whatever you do, don't let
anyone come in here,
okay? I don't want to be
found. Do you
understand?
Eek, I hear their\nfootsteps!!!
I'm counting on you!

Captain! Did an individual
named W.E.L.C.H.
V.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D. come this
way!?
She ran that way!
She's hiding in there.
Why do you ask?
So I guess she's gone to\nthe bridge?
Perfect. If we follow her to\nthe bridge, we can trap\nher there!

Hehehe... There is no
escape now! We are
coming for you, W.E.L.C.H.
V.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D.!!!
That's right! Let's go get\nher while she's at the\nbridge!
Whew... I finally lost them.

Say, you've got some
acting chops! Those
suckers didn't suspect a
thing!
Thank you, Captain! I knew\nwe could rely on you!
We've got you now, Welch!\nNo use hiding any more!
...Wait. There's nobody\nhere!
Eve! Those footsteps\nbelong to the W.E.L.C.H.\nV.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D.!!!
They appear to lead that\nway... She must have gone\nto the bridge!
You won't be getting away\nfrom us! Come on, Coro!

Muwahahaha, I can read
you like a book! I knew you
wouldn't lie, Captain
Honesty. All part of my
plan!

Sometimes the best way
to fool an enemy is to fool
an ally. I was actually
hiding somewhere else!
Are you impressed?\nSometimes I'm so smart, I\nscare myself!
Oh, er...
Well, Welch stole a device\nthat Coro and I were\nbuilding and ran off...
What kind of device? It's\na...well...you know.
That doesn't matter. The\nimportant thing is that\nWelch stole it!!!

Eve, she is not in this
area. I suggest we go to
the bridge and scan the
ship!
An excellent plan. We'll\nfind her!!!
Whew... Looks like I lost\nthem.
Nice work, Captain! I'm\nimpressed!
Now I can finally focus on\nmy research!
What kind of research?\nHold your horses, Cap!
It's about this strangely\nglowing silver box I\nswiped...

Coro and Eve have been
racking their brains over
it, so it must be something
special!

As a creator of items, I
can't help but want to
analyze it, analyze it, and
analyze it some more.
First things first, better\nflip the switch!
What the...!? Nothing\nhappened! Well, THAT'S\nboring!!!
Talk about a waste of my\ntime.
Well, at least I can punch\nit. POW!!!

What the...? Is that snow?
It's kind of...elegant. I like
it. Not too bad for a
useless hunk of junk!

...Say, just how much snow
is gonna fall, anyway!?
This is turning into a
blizzard... ACHOO!!!
Brrr... It's so cold... I'm\ngonna freeze...

Are you okay!? Coro,
hurry up! You stop the
device!!! I'll rescue our
friends!
Understood!
Graaah... Whad a derrible\nding do habben...
Why did you make such a\ndangerous thing!?
... Ahem. Who stole it,\nagain? And then who\nbroke it?
But... I mean... I'm an item\ncreator, so...

Captain! The individual
named W.E.L.C.H.
V.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D. is now
prohibited from touching
any devices on this ship!
Wait a second, aren't you\noverreacting a little!?

We narrowly averted
disaster! What if you had
destroyed something with
your unauthorized device
manipulations!!!
...I'm sorry.
Why play around with a\nsnow device...?
Well...
Oh, yes! We need to make\nsure the snow didn't\ndamage any equipment!
H-hey! Coro, come back\nhere!

Event achievement
unlocked! Take a look by
tapping the Achievement
Button.

Captain. W.E.L.C.H.
V.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D. has been
behaving suspiciously
lately...

No, none of the ship's
equipment has been
damaged since the
recent...incident. In fact,
quite the opposite.
Um, Captain, you got a\nmoment?
Eek, she is here!!!
Hehe. Hello, Cory. You're\nlooking chipper as always.

Cory...? I am not sure I like
that... We AI are not used
to your concept of
"nicknames."
Huh? Whaddya mean\n"different"? I'm the same\nWelch as always!
Well...other than my\npointing stick. I don't quite\nfeel right without it.

Oh, that pointing stick!!! It
broke in the strong winds
of the blizzard the other
day, did it not?
Actually, that darn\nblizzard is exactly what I\nwanted to talk about.

First, I wanted to
apologize to everyone for
the trouble I caused. I'm
sorry!

I know I acted terribly... I
just get carried away
when I see something
mysterious.
I guess it comes with the\nterritory when you create\nitems for a living.
Why do I care so much\nabout creating items?

Well... It's kind of
embarrassing to talk
about the past, but since
you asked...

When I was little, there
was this old lady in our
neighborhood who called
herself an "item creator."

All the things she crafted
looked real cheap, but
they made a lot of people
happy.

I bragged that I could
make more useful and
amazing things, and that's
when I started creating.
...But the people only\nadmired her work. They\ndidn't care about mine.

I was furious and took it
out against the whole
town. I insisted my items
were better, no matter
what they thought.
It was then that the old\nlady appeared, and patted\nme on the head.

You're smarter than me,
she said. "But you only
use your head to think of
ways to earn praise."

Look around you. Think of
all the people you could
make happy with your
inventions.
That's when I decided to\nbecome the old lady's\napprentice.
I wanted to learn how to\ncreate items that would\nmake people smile!
I see. So that is what\ndrives you to...
No. I was out of line. I\ncan't use my past as an\nexcuse for my actions.

I want you to punish
me...and make sure the
punishment fits the crime!
It's the only way I'll learn...

You are right, Welch! Still...
I may have been too
harsh, as well. Everyone
makes a mistake or two...

Yes, however, my mistake
put the entire crew at
risk. I don't expect anyone
to forgive me for that!
Hate the sin, not the\nsinner... Good point,\nCaptain!!!
Are you sure?
All riiight!!!
People have been looking\nat me funny ever since it\nhappened...

Every time I try to touch
the console, I can feel
their eyes burning holes in
me!
What?
I-I mean... Um...
Anyway, this means that\nthe captain has officially\nforgiven me, right?

Of course, no one as
honorable as our captain
would ever go back on
their word.
And with that, I shall take\nmy leave! Thank you,\nCaptain!
I knew it. W.E.L.C.H.\nV.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D. is not to be\ntrifled with!

Event achievement
unlocked! Take a look by
tapping the Achievement
Button.
(Coro, hurry up! The\ncaptain will be here any\nsecond!)
(Argh, please do not rush\nme! This is delicate work!)
(Hey! No goofing around!\nGo on, hide behind the\nconsole!)
Merry Christmas, Captain!!!
Hehe, were you surprised,\nCaptain?
It does not feel like we are\nthat far from Earth, now.
Seeing as today is\nChristmas...
We wanted to recreate\nthe holiday spirit!
We made it snow on the\nbridge, so that you could\nenjoy a white Christmas!

Ah, but don't worry! We
made absolutely certain
that none of the
electronics on the bridge
would be harmed!

So THAT'S why you had a
snow-making device. You
kept whispering about it,
so I thought it was
something more amazing...
W.E.L.C.H V.I.N.E.Y.A.R.D,\ndo not punch the\nsnow-making device!
I won't. I promise!
Anyway, Welch, this is for\nyou!
A new pointing stick!
Why...?

We know you tried to
mend your old one after it
broke the other day, but it
looked a little worse for
wear...

Not to mention difficult to
use. We could tell you
weren't completely
satisfied with it.

So we created an exact
replica based on the data
we had of your previous
pointing stick. The shape
and material is identical.
What do you think?
What's the matter? Welch,\nare you all right?
Ahahahahaha! The grip,\nthe length, and most of all,\nthe way it extends...
...It's like a deluxe model!

Of course I'd have friends
as good as you guys! I
accept your splendid
tribute!
Tribute...? It's a present!
Well, as long as you're\nhappy, I guess that's all\nthat matters!
Of course! How could a\none-of-a-kind genius like\nme NOT be happy?
Now, for starters, let me\nanalyze the biggest\nmystery on this ship!
Coro's thinking circuits!
What!? Me!?
Hey, stay away from me!!! I\ndon't like the look of that\ntool!
Captain! Eve! Stop\nlaughing, and save me\nfrom her!

Stop running away! I need
to analyze you! You're a
vital part of my research
as the Chief Item Creator
of Welch's Laboratory!
Stooop!
